query:
SELECT 
            l.id, 
            l.from_note_id, 
            l.to_note_id, 
            l.to_url, 
            l.kind, 
            l.score, 
            l.created_at_utc,
            COALESCE(
                substring(nrc.content from 1 for 100),
                'Linked note'
            ) as snippet
        FROM link l
        LEFT JOIN note_revised_current nrc ON nrc.note_id = l.to_note_id
        WHERE l.from_note_id = $1
        ORDER BY l.score DESC, l.created_at_utc DESC
